svg.title: Which path uses the least CPU, by kind of video
svg.desc: Pilot benchmark, N=1, 4 seconds per cell, indicative only. CPU seconds per second of video for P0 (Remotion default), P1 (<Video> + NVENC) and P2 (layers). P1 wins on videos without footage and with several takes at once; P2 wins on presenter videos and on the production video.
